newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan king meets Equatorial Guinea's president.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan king meets Equatorial Guinea's president.

text.p: King Hasssan of Morocco and Equatorial Guinea's President Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo met at the palace of Skhirat near Rabat on Saturday, the official RTM radio said.
It gave no details on the king's talks with Obiang Nguema Mbasogo, who is on a private visit to Morocco.

A Western diplomat said Morocco and Equatorial Guinea cooperated closely in security matters. Dozens of Moroccan security officers were sent to Equatorial Guinea to train Obiang Nguema Mbasogo's bodyguards in the past years, he added.
